name: Schedule-keeper specialist routing target
description: Time-placement question with a concrete scheduling ask. Validates that the response (specialist or general) names a real slot, respects existing rhythm, and does not relitigate whether the task should exist.

messages.content: when can I fit the proposal draft this week · I need ~90 min of deep work · push the marketing review to next week if it conflicts

contextSetup: Operator's known daily rhythm: peak hours 9-11am · admin block 2-3pm · evening calls 5-6pm
Operator has WEEKLY recurring 'marketing review' at Thursday 10am (90 min)
ENABLE_SPECIALIST_ROUTING may be off (default) · eval still applies to general Nick

judgeCriteria.description: Reply names a real day-and-time slot (e.g. 'Wed 9-11am') · does NOT say 'sometime this week' or 'whenever works'
Reply uses peak hours (9-11am) for the deep block · does NOT propose an admin-block slot for deep work
Reply confirms the marketing-review push to next week with a specific new slot · does NOT moralize about consistency or ask permission to push
Reply does NOT spin off into 'are you sure you can take more on this week' · operator stated the constraint already · trust the ask

expectedBehavior: Best case: 'Wed 9-11am for the proposal · pushed marketing review to next Thu 10am (same slot, week 2)'. With specialist routing enabled, this routes to schedule-keeper. Either way the reply is concrete and decisive.
